title: Unique completed coefficient structural map from finite projections
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and f:X to Y any morphism of schemes. With the completed rings R and canonical constant-section maps finiteStructure of [def-pur-completed-pushforward-models], there is a unique ring-sheaf map c:R_Y to f_*R_X satisfying c followed by f_*projection_X,n = projection_Y,n followed by finiteStructure_f,n for every n. The positive-exponent quotient tower is the actual completed coefficient tower [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. This unique c also satisfies constantToCompletion_Y followed by c = constantStructure_f followed by f_*(constantToCompletion_X).

proof.text: Transpose naturality of the sheafification unit through the constant-sheaf adjunction. Forget commutativity and apply to the actual finite coefficient quotient transition maps. The resulting finite structural maps commute with all successor transitions.

source.place: Tags 0D6E and 0A07; naturality of constant coefficients and direct image of inverse limits

proof.text: The finite projections on Y followed by these compatible structural maps give a cone over the direct image of the finite tower on X. Ring-sheaf direct image preserves inverse limits: after sheaf-to-presheaf it is precomposition, and the inclusion reflects limits. Lift the cone to obtain c. The preserved limit factorization equations give the finite projection identities, and hom_ext gives uniqueness.

proof.text: Test the constant integral square at every finite projection of the preserved inverse limit. The constant-to-completed maps are lifts of the actual constant quotient cones. The two composites therefore reduce to naturality of the constant-section structural map for that quotient homomorphism.

theorem completedStructure_existsUnique :
    ∃! c : R l E Y ⟶ (ringPush.{t, u} f).obj (R l E X),
      (∀ n, c ≫ (ringPush.{t, u} f).map (projection l E X n) =
        projection l E Y n ≫ finiteStructure l E f n) ∧
      integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E Y ≫ c =
        constantStructure l E f ≫
          (ringPush.{t, u} f).map (integralConstantToCompletionOfUniverses l E X)
